title: LoRA & Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning — Build the Change from Two Thin Matrices
key_insight: The inner width is called rank. Lower rank uses fewer trainable values; higher rank can express a richer change but costs more memory and compute.
body:
## Build the Change from Two Thin Matrices

A full weight update is a large rectangle. LoRA represents its change as the product of two thinner matrices.

The inner width is called rank. Lower rank uses fewer trainable values; higher rank can express a richer change but costs more memory and compute.

A scale controls adapter strength. Targeting attention projections is common, but the best modules depend on the task and model.
common_mistakes: LoRA retrains every base parameter by definition.
An adapter works with any unrelated base model.
Lower precision can never affect speed or quality.
